fields.title: Welcome to Blogger
fields.content:
Hello and welcome to Blogger! This is a simple place to write and share your thoughts.

You can add a new post with a cover image, read any post on its own page, edit it, or delete it. Start by clicking "+ New Post" at the top.

fields.title: 5 Tips for Learning Django
fields.content:
1. Understand the request/response cycle: URL -> view -> template.
2. Use template inheritance so every page shares one base layout.
3. Always use {% url %} instead of hard-coded links.
4. Learn the ORM well: create, filter, update and delete objects.
5. Write tests early — they catch mistakes before your users do.

fields.title: Ronaldo
fields.content:
The best player in the world.

Cristiano Ronaldo has won league titles in England, Spain and Italy, five Ballon d'Or awards, and is the all-time top scorer in international football.

fields.title: My Morning Coffee Routine
fields.content:
Every good day of coding starts with a good cup of coffee.

I grind the beans fresh, brew a V60, and spend ten quiet minutes planning what I want to build before opening my laptop.
